returns._0: address The address of the gateway implementation.

approveContractCallWithMint(bytes,bytes3.notice: Approves a contract call with token transfer.

burnToken(bytes,bytes32).notice: Burns tokens of a given symbol, either through an external deposit handler or a token defined burn method.

callContract(string,string,bytes).notice: Calls a contract on the specified destination chain with a given payload. This function is the entry point for general message passing between chains.

callContractWithToken(string,string,byte.notice: Calls a contract on the specified destination chain with a given payload and token amount. This function is the entry point for general message passing with token transfer between chains.

contractId().notice: Gets the contract ID of the Axelar Gateway.

deployToken(bytes,bytes32).notice: Deploys a new token or registers an existing token in the gateway contract itself.

execute(bytes).notice: Executes a batch of commands signed by the Axelar network. There are a finite set of command types that can be executed.

governance().notice: Gets the address of governance, should be the address of InterchainGovernance.

implementation().notice: Gets the address of the gateway implementation contract.

isCommandExecuted(bytes32).notice: Checks whether a command with a given command ID has been executed.

isContractCallAndMintApproved(bytes32,st.notice: Checks whether a contract call with token has been approved by the gateway.

isContractCallApproved(bytes32,string,st.notice: Checks whether a contract call has been approved by the gateway.

mintLimiter().notice: Gets the address of the mint limiter, should be the address of Multisig.

mintToken(bytes,bytes32).notice: Transfers a specific amount of tokens to an account, based on the provided symbol.

sendToken(string,string,string,uint256).notice: Send the specified token to the destination chain and address.

setTokenMintLimits(string[],uint256[]).notice: Sets the transfer limits for an array of tokens.

setup(bytes).notice: Sets up the governance and mint limiter roles, and transfers operatorship if necessary. This function is called by the proxy during initial deployment, and optionally called during gateway upgrades.

tokenAddresses(string).notice: Gets the address of a specific token using its symbol.

tokenMintAmount(string).notice: Gets the transfer amount for a specific token symbol within the configured epoch.

tokenMintLimit(string).notice: Gets the transfer limit for a specific token symbol within the configured epoch.

transferGovernance(address).notice: Transfers the governance role to a new address.

transferMintLimiter(address).notice: Transfers the mint limiter role to a new address.

transferOperatorship(bytes,bytes32).notice: Transfers operatorship with the provided data by calling the transferOperatorship function on the auth module.

upgrade(address,bytes32,bytes).notice: Upgrades the contract to a new implementation.

validateContractCall(bytes32,string,stri.notice: Called on the destination chain gateway by the recipient of the cross-chain contract call to validate it and only allow execution if this function returns true.

validateContractCallAndMint(bytes32,stri.notice: Called on the destination chain gateway to validate the approval of a contract call with token transfer and only allow execution if this function returns true.
